paragraphs: His son Abba is mentioned at the end of Rosh Hashanah.[^1]

notes.text: Abba is the son, not the father. Here ר״ה is the tractate Rosh Hashanah. Its stored William Davidson Edition at 35a explicitly says Abba son of Rav Binyamin bar Chiyya. Hyman's supplied heading abbreviates the father's title; the older note called it Rabbi, but that expansion is not explicit. The heading retains R', while the named edition's Rav is recorded separately.
